project.title: Db2 AI Data Analyst: Self-Correcting Text-to-SQL with Vector Memory and EXPLAIN Guardrails
project.short_description: Ask business questions in plain English. A LangChain + Gemini agent writes Db2 SQL, validates it with Db2 EXPLAIN against a cost budget, runs it as a SELECT-only Db2 user, self-corrects on Db2 errors, charts and explains the result, and learns from approved answers stored as VECTOR embeddings in Db2.

features_used: VECTOR(768, FLOAT32) column + VECTOR_DISTANCE(..., COSINE) similarity search
EXPLAIN PLAN + EXPLAIN_STATEMENT / EXPLAIN_OPERATOR / EXPLAIN_STREAM (cost guardrail, access plan)
SQL PL stored procedure with OUT parameter (audit logging)
Least-privilege user with GRANT SELECT only (read-only execution)
SYSCAT catalog introspection (tables, columns, references, COMMENT ON remarks)
Relational schema with PK/FK/CHECK constraints, composite indexes, reporting views
Window functions (LAG, OVER PARTITION BY), CTEs, FETCH FIRST
